exec: pm.test("includes a REMAINDER transaction", function () { const types = pm.response.json().data.transactions.map(t => t.type); pm.expect(types).to.include("REMAINDER"); });

description.content: Estimated income tax for the current SA tax year, calculated from the freelancer's PAID transactions.

exec: pm.test("estimatedTax is a non-negative number", function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.estimatedTax).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(d.estimatedTax).to.be.at.least(0); });
pm.test("after-tax income = taxable income - tax", function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.afterTaxIncome).to.eql(d.taxableIncome - d.estimatedTax); });

pm.test("includes tax year, breakdown and disclaimer", function () { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.taxYear).to.match(/^\d{4}\/\d{2}$/); pm.expect(d.breakdown).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(d.disclaimer).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("includes related-record counts", function () { const u = pm.response.json().data.user; pm.expect(u).to.have.property("gigsCount"); pm.expect(u).to.have.property("bookingsCount"); });

description.content: Demonstrates the two extra security features: account lockout after repeated failed logins, and token revocation on logout.
Five consecutive failures lock the account. Even the CORRECT password is refused with 423 until the lock expires.

exec: pm.test("message says the account is locked", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/locked/i); });

item.name: Get Current User - After Logout (revoked token rejected)

description.content: The token is still correctly signed and unexpired, but its id is on the revocation list.

exec: pm.test("message says the session has ended", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/session has ended/i); });

description.content: Full HustleHub+ Part 2 API collection: auth, gigs, bookings, transactions, income, and admin. Run top-to-bottom (Newman respects request order) - later requests depend on variables captured by earlier ones. Requires a running server with a connected MongoDB database (real Atlas or otherwise). The Admin folder requires an existing admin account matching the adminEmail/adminPassword environment variables (see the environment file notes).
